status.description: the tracker's own word (open, opened, Active, a custom ClickUp status …)

open.description: normalized: false once the item is closed/resolved/done — a match that is not open means a defect that came back is a regression

dismissed.description: present (true) only when the tracker says the item was closed WITHOUT a fix: not planned, won't fix, invalid, duplicate, rejected, removed. Such an item is never `open`, and a defect that reappears is not a regression of a fix
